name: inkdrop-git-sync
description: Bidirectional synchronization between Inkdrop notes and a Git repository

scripts.check: node --check lib/inkdrop-git-sync.js && node --check lib/sync-engine.js && node --check lib/git-service.js && node --check lib/inkdrop-adapter.js

enabled.title: Enable scheduled synchronization
enabled.description: Run a cycle on the interval below. Enable only after a successful preview and one manual cycle.

mode.title: Operating mode
mode.description: export: one-way, Inkdrop to Git (existing installations). sync: two-way; requires a new dedicated folder.

interval.title: Sync interval
interval.description: Synchronization interval in minutes. Changes apply immediately.

token.title: GitHub Token
token.description: GitHub token with access to the repository. Passed to Git through GIT_ASKPASS; never written to the remote URL or the logs.

repository.title: GitHub repository
repository.description: Private knowledge repository in owner/repository format.

syncFolder.title: Dedicated sync folder
syncFolder.description: A new dedicated folder for the Git checkout. Managed notes are stored under notes/.

includedBooks.title: Included notebooks
includedBooks.description: Optional comma-separated notebook names or IDs; sub-notebooks are included. Empty includes all notebooks.
